metadata.source: local OHLCV replay of deployed screen templates
caveats: TradingView's screener cannot be rewound: screen ranking, confluence scores, catalyst checks and the live gate are not replayed.
Signals are evaluated on locally cached OHLCV for a current S&P 500 snapshot (survivorship bias remains).
Entries are next-bar opens; exits are ATR stop/target (2.0/3.0) with a 15-bar cap; stop wins on same-bar ties; fees 10 bps + slippage 5 bps/side.
Fundamental / RS-rank filters that need live data are recorded as not applied and treated as not matched (same honesty rule as the validation engine).
This is simulated replay evidence, not forward paper-trade evidence and not a P&L promise.
